classification.evidence: sketch('front', 5): the script puts the plane at y=+5 and pulls toward -Y, so the pad fills y in [-5, 5]; FreeCAD's XZ_Plane offsets 5 along ITS normal (-Y), plane at y=-5, pad y in [-15, -5]. Volume 12000 and 6 faces agree, the position does not (centre of mass y 0 vs -10). The script's convention is written down and pinned: packages/script/src/model-types.ts NAMED_PLANE_FRAMES has xz n=[0,1,0] (offset direction) while SWEEP_DIR has xz=-1 ('MEASURED, not derived (xz pulls -Y)'), kept so no existing document moves. Same-geometry variants with offset 0 on the front plane (pad-basic__front-plane, pad-symmetric__front-plane with the +len/2 idiom) all MATCH.
